I have farmed in the North West for many decades and know this small beans plot well. I will apply a small amount of NPK fertilizer since I already bought some for my cereal plots, and I will add manure from my animals because it keeps the soil healthy. I must spray pesticide to protect the cowpea from pod borers and beetles, which are a constant problem here, but I do not irrigate as we rely on the rains. My family and I can manage the weeding, spraying, and harvesting on this quarter-hectare plot without bringing in outside workers.
